Title: Feast to Famine
Description: Speak with the Elder Saatvik Agrawal to find out if you're welcome in Corinth.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="guard_laughmed" />Well, isn't that grand? People starving in the streets, everyone whispering the Sorceress Medea's cursed us, <g id="guard_shrugbrief" />and now tidings of evil. What's next?
InProgressResponse: <g id="guard_headtilthmm" />Something else you need? If so, I suggest you look elsewhere. <g id="guard_dismissLeft" />Move along… else you want trouble.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_gestureright" />You see this poor, wretched thing? A month ago, <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />my friend Winston here baked the best bread in Corinth! Now… this is his fate for all eternity.

Title: Rest Assured
Description: Visit the Inn and speak with Innkeep Verildis Jannsen to check in. Discover an old friend at the Inn.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="litearmor_tiltheadremember" />That's a long and sordid tale… suffice to say - Medea hasn't been seen here in decades, <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />but Corinth pays regular tribute to the Sorceress.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />Please, speak with the inkeep at the Southern Breeze. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Even travelers need a place they can call home for a night!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="grace_welcome" />Where've you been hiding? I was afraid I'd have to go back to the beach and search for you.

Title: Money Talks
Description: Visit the Trading Post and one of the Storage Sheds in Corinth. Then speak with Grace at the Inn.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="grace_gestureL" />There's a trading post here. Not exactly thriving, <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />but you could at least get yourself some new clothes.
InProgressResponse: <g id="grace_gesturebothhands" />You have all that coin jingling in your pockets. <g id="grace_convince2" />Go and spend it! And you never know when someone might steal it when you're not looking.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="grace_doubt" />Well there's a pretty little ditty for you… some romanticized notions of Aeternum, I'd say. <g id="grace_headshakeno" />Grace O'Malley won't be calling this place home. I'll tell you that.

Title: Desperate Measures
Description: Visit Golden Fields to gather food to resupply Corinth.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="grace_pshaw" />Hah! That'll be the day! I'm no farmer, and besides, <g id="grace_lean" />I caught wind of a pirate hideout not so far from town. Thinking maybe there's some loot there.
InProgressResponse: <g id="grace_understand" />Like I said, I'll be seeing you around. Long as you don't go losing your soul somewhere. <g id="grace_frustrated" />Ah here... I can't believe I'm even saying these things.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Well, it's not as much as I'd hoped, but it's certainly better than nothing. <g id="litearmor_agree1" />This grain will keep us fed for a few more days at least.

Title: Firsthand Accounts
Description: Rescue and talk to farmers who survived what happened at Golden Fields.
PlayerPrompt: "I'll check the rest of the farm."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />Your confidence seems matched by your skill, so I welcome the help. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Indeed, if you rescue anyone you can find, <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />we might be able to get some answers.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />If there are any farmers, or Druids, I hope they can give us some insight into exactly what transpired here.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />That, my friend, was most impressive! These vegetables may make all the difference.

Title: Tracking the Tribute
Description: Visit the Iron Rose Garrison and find out what happened to the Sorceress Medea's Tribute.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />Yes, they were hired by Medea herself, to protect and transport the tribute, <g id="litearmor_converseright" />but the town had engaged them for security as well.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />Uh, while I appreciate your help gathering food for Corinth, we need to know why the Company of the Iron Rose wasn't here to protect the farm.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_darnit" priority=""high" />I don't understand, my comrades were hardened soldiers.<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> Tough bastards, one and all.

Title: Tracking the Tribute
Description: Visit the Iron Rose Garrison and find out what happened to the Sorceress Medea's Tribute.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />Yes, they were hired by Medea herself, to protect and transport the tribute, <g id="litearmor_converseright" />but the town had engaged them for security as well.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />Uh, while I appreciate your help gathering food for Corinth, we need to know why the Company of the Iron Rose wasn't here to protect the farm.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_darnit" priority=""high" />I don't understand, my comrades were hardened soldiers.<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> Tough bastards, one and all.

Title: Iron and Blood
Description: Rescue any surviving members of the Company of the Iron Rose and discover the fate of Sergeant Cotheran, then meet Leovix Silva at the Iron Keep.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />Yes, but I can’t be the only one! <g id="male_dontknow" />I've fought alongside these soldiers against impossible odds!
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />I just need a moment before I go and face Commander Merrill. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />She will no doubt order me to recount every tragic detail.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />What a relief to see you again! <g id="male_shakehead" />I'm afraid that the same curse that befell the garrison has struck the Iron Keep as well! <g id="female_disappointed" priority="high"/>It's swarming with my Lost brethren!

Title: Commander's Correspondence
Description: Search Iron Keep to find any information about the missing tribute to Medea. Bring anything you find back to Leovix at the tavern in Corinth.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_notsure" />It could be, but I can't imagine why. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />We've delivered her damn tribute for more years than I can count. <g id="male_crossarmsupset /> It makes no sense she'd turn on us.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You're a brave soul to go charging in to fight the members of my order. Even Lost, they will be formidable.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />It's good to see you… heh, <g id="male_chuckle" />almost called you 'comrade'! I'm glad you made it safely. <g id="female_spreadarms" />It seems this disaster has spread all across Windsward.

Title: The Missing Tribute
Description: Find out what really happened to the tribute to Medea by talking to the Speaker of the Winds and the Captain of the Guard.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />That beady-eyed little bastard! I'll see <g id="male_righthandAngry" />him tarred and feathered if this is his fault, <g id="male_realize" />but wait… if Dupont took the tribute, <g id="male_pointleft"/>the Speaker would've known.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_righthandAngry" />I swear, if the Speaker doesn't own up to his mistake, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />you'll have to extract my sabaton from his arse.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />You don't have to tell me, I already heard - <g id="male_righthandAngry" />that weasel Dupont let the tribute <g id="male_converseleft" />get stolen by pirates!

Title: The Pirate Problem
Description: Travel to the camp site by Buccaneer Creek. Talk to Grace. Then look for Pirate Treasures at Buccaneer Creek.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nodproud" />I think the Speaker and that fool Dupont are hiding something, and when I find out what it is, <g id="female_smackfist" />they'll answer for it. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I promise you that.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_youknow" />Don't forget to set yourself a campsite. <g id="male_shrugBrief" />If you get in over your head, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />it's a safe place to go back to.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_youknow" />Well, this was a fortunate coincidence. For me, at least. <g id="male_shakehead" />I wasn't exactly thrilled with the prospect of spending eternity in a cage. <g id="male_willcoverit" />So thank you… again.

Title: Web of Lies
Description: Find evidence that Marcel was here with the pirates. Recover the stolen Verdant Gemstone.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />Get yourself into the Captain's quarters within the camp. I'd like to know if he has the Verdant Gemstone stashed somewhere.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> How ironic would it be if it was the pirates' greed that caused this mess? I suppose it's always something unexpected, though.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_apologizesmall" />I'm sorry to dash your friend's dreams of wealth, <g id="female_nodyes" />but she should know, it's quite impossible to leave the island. <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />The stormwall is… a force of nature.

Title: Verdant Restoration
Description: Climb Mirador Shrine, complete the ancient puzzle, restore the gemstone, then speak with Nessa.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_waghand01" />Oh no! I promise you! I'm not just saying this so you'll help. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />I think you'll agree, the situation is a bit desperate here, and you are capable.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />If that Gemstone isn't restored soon, I'm afraid the situation could get even worse.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />Well met, newcomer. It's rare to see someone who's just arrived become such a pivotal figure in Corinth, but <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Nessa speaks very highly of you.

Title: Hidden Power
Description: Explore the Oracle Therismos to find the Ancient Map leading to the other Verdant Gemstones.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Mostly just how little we truly know.<g id="litearmor_willcoverit" /> I've dedicated several lifetimes to studying Aeternum's history, but much of it remains a mystery.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />We're very fortunate you came to Aeternum when you did. <g id="litearmor_headtilthmm" />I have a feeling historians of the future will be studying records of your feats.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Excellent! I'm afraid we've not had much luck with these scrolls, <g id="female_takeItem8s" priority="high"/>but let's see what you brought back… ooh, yes this is clearly some sort of map.

Title: The Speaker's Crimes
Description: Join Saatvik and Leovix in the Town Hall to confront the Speaker of the Winds with proof of his crimes.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />After you left, frustrations boiled over. Elder Saatvik insisted they wait for your return, <g id="female_nodyes" />but Leovix was quite past the point of reason.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />I do hope you can resolve the situation with the Speaker peacefully and quickly. We have much work to do.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />So the Speaker himself had the second gemstone. How did I not see that coming?

Title: Verdant Connections
Description: Return the Verdant Gemstone to Eldergate by climbing to the top of the ruins.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodding" />That does seem to be the next logical step, so you have my support. <g id="female_spreadarms" />We'll continue with the map. The shrine is to the <g id="female_pointRight" />southwest of the city.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Is that something new I hear on the wind? I believe it's the sound of… <g id="male_nodunderstand" />yes, it's the sound of procrastination!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="grace_welcome" />Well, look at you, breathing life back into this wee, sad town. <g id="grace_headnodyes" />You almost make me want to pitch in.

Title: Jewel of the Sea
Description: Talk to Nessa near the Pirate Den known as Hecker's Haven. Then enter the Den and challenge Captain Korrapati to recover the third Verdant Gemstone.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="grace_convince1" />You've got it covered. And I’m starting to grow moss on my backside.
InProgressResponse: <g id="grace_goaway" />Go on, then! You better not be getting sentimental on me.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Splendid! You clearly weren't eaten by the alligator. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />And you don't even have any rips on your clothes.

Title: The Spirit Returns
Description: Return the third Verdant Gemstone to Sirius and solve the ancient puzzle.
PlayerPrompt: "Just glad this is the last one."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Agreed! While you head to Sirius, <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'll visit town and make sure preparations are under way to resume the tribute.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_male_headnodyes" />It's very exciting, isn't it? <g id="female_spreadarms" />Once we've restored the jewel at Sirius, things will get better. You'll see.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Well, so much for my theory that Medea would be understanding, <g id="male_explain" />but of course… keep in mind, she doesn't have all the facts.

Title: The Path of Thorns
Description: Infiltrate Thornhall, the most holy site of Windsward's druids, and find Medea. Convince her to give the region a second chance.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Well, we have to at least try, don't we? <g id="male_handheart" />Or perhaps as the last druid, I should be volunteering as tribute. <g id="male_shakehead" />Can't say I'm too excited about that.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_worry" />Though I'm extremely nervous about encountering Medea, I have to confess, I'm also a bit excited to finally meet her.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="grace_spreadarms" />Behold, the gifted warrior who bested me approaches. <g id="grace_convince" />I am sorely tempted to test you once again, <g id="grace_shrugDontknow" />but your friend Nessa has now shared the whole story.

Title: Old Man by the River
Description: Travel north to Fisherman's Bend to find the Old Man that Medea believes can help expel the Corruption from your mind.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="grace_sorry" />There is a much greater battle brewing, one I can take no part in. But you… <g id="grace_convince1" />you are destined to play a role in it, for good or for evil.
InProgressResponse: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />There is nothing more for either of us here. Our destinies lie elsewhere, but we may cross paths again.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Away with you, ghost. You'll scare away the fish. I remember you not and care not to, even if I could.

Title: Old Man by the River
Description: Travel north to Fisherman's Bend to find the Old Man that Medea believes can help expel the Corruption from your mind.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="grace_sorry" />There is a much greater battle brewing, one I can take no part in. But you… <g id="grace_convince1" />you are destined to play a role in it, for good or for evil.
InProgressResponse: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />There is nothing more for either of us here. Our destinies lie elsewhere, but we may cross paths again.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Away with you, ghost. You'll scare away the fish. I remember you not and care not to, even if I could.

Title: Brushed by Fate
Description: Return Fude Hinode's set of brushes to her from where she left them at Eldergate.
PlayerPrompt: "Looks like there's a label on them."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: [If found, please return to the tavern in Corinth - signed F. Hinode.]
InProgressResponse: [The brushes are unlikely to make it back to the settlement without your help.]
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: My brushes! Thank you, thank you! I’ve painted so many places I forgot where I left them.

Title: Seeds of Steel
Description: Find and read the creed of the Iron Rose.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: To join the Iron Rose Company. Stalwart bastions of valor they are. I don't have a copy of the creed.
InProgressResponse: I know all the Iron Rose mercenaries. Commander Merrill, Captain Leovix Silva, Cotheran the Red, Gideon Sturm!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You're back! I had heard that many of them became Lost. I was worried about you.

Title: A Garden of Iron
Description: Obtain an Iron Rose Sword for Roya.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I agree. Problem is, I don't have a sword. And Iron Rose soldiers ought to have an Iron Rose blade.
InProgressResponse: I hear Iron Rose swords are weighted differently than most. Their center of gravity is oddly located, increasing thrusting power.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: A warrior is no more noble or sharp than the iron of the blade he carries. No more graceful than the way he treats others.

Title: By Any Other Name
Description: Deliver Roya's application to the missing mercenary.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I wrote an application letter and took it to Captain Silva. But he's head of the townsguard now.
InProgressResponse: Thank you for all you have done for me. Perhaps it's time I embrace the path of all great bakers like… uh… I can't think of any to be honest with you.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Darkness. Death. A baleful curse. That's all that is left of our order. Company of Lies and Ashes is more like it.

Title: Supply Run
Description: Craft tools, then gather and refine the materials requested by Taleas Serrano.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />Tell that to the annual tribute. <g id="sit_gestureleftM" />That last collection was a kick in the nethers.
InProgressResponse: <g id="sit_headshakeno" />Our stores are as barren as a gravedigger's prospects.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hey, look at this! <g id="sit_nod" />Something approaching an actual stockpile, I haven't seen that in months!

Title: Fire Up the Forge
Description: Craft an Iron Longsword at the Forge and bring it to Mason Zhang Haoyu in Corinth when you have completed your task.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: There's trouble with the tribute? I hadn't heard that. I was talking about the Lost overrunning the farms.
InProgressResponse: Open the satchel of ore I gave you, smelt it, then hammer out an iron sword.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Now, let's see your handiwork… impressive. Quite impressive. Either you've done this before, or you've got a knack for it.

Title: A Town in Need
Description: Check the Corinth Town Board to discover more ways to help Corinth prosper
ObjectiveProposalResponse: @06A_TS_03_LearnTownBoard_proposal
InProgressResponse: @06A_TS_03_LearnTownBoard_incomplete
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: @06A_TS_03_LearnTownBoard_response

Title: Just Dessert
Description: Travel to Sweet Acre Farm to recover Kathrijn's Blueberry Compote and harvest Strawberries, Blueberries, Squash or Corn.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: No, dessert! Who could turn down some tasty treats?
InProgressResponse: Those strawberries are going to go bad if you don't get to them soon! And who could resist some homemade blueberry compote!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You did it! You got the desserts! Oh, there will be a feast in Corinth tonight, I tell you! But first, how about we try a little here?

Title: Pirates of Spice
Description: Travel to the area around Buccaneer Creek and Mother's Tears to locate the missing spices.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I'm going to help make it! But first, I need something those pirates stole from me.
InProgressResponse: I need my saffron, pepper, and cardamom from the pirates at Mother’s Tears.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Sweet success! I can smell those spices from here! The fiery peppers, the rich scent of saffron, the warming aroma of cardamom.

Title: The Bear of Scratchrock
Description: Hunt Pumas in the area and bring down the bear of Scratchrock Burrow. Report back to Tsui Fen when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />You look tough enough to help hunt pumas. They provide good food for the settlement, and hides for the tanner's guild.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_shakehead" />This bear is unnaturally savage. It has plenty of natural prey, so it shouldn't keep mauling passersby.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_takeItem8s" />Wonderful! This will make a pleasant change from all the wolf meat we've been eating. A little variety is good for morale.

Title: Shot Across the Bow
Description: Sabotage cannons and light striped powderkegs on fire at the pirate stronghold. Defeat Shamgar then return to Michael Lewis.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_youknow" />You know how the Swarmancers destroyed the farm? Ruined the windmills? Made it hard to get anything done?
InProgressResponse: Damn pirates, think they can go around raiding decent folk with impunity. Let's see how they like having their homes raided.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />That'll teach them! I could see those explosions from here! With any luck, that will bring us a spell of peace from the pirates.

Title: Warp and Weft
Description: Collect Loom Patterns and Fabric Samples from Sirius and Stoneview Seabreak.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Oh let me tell you. Crafting takes time, and my method would be a bit faster.
InProgressResponse: Every second you stay here is another thread frayed, another shirt torn, another cloth dirtied.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh. My thanks! How utterly divine! Look at this cloth! It has withstood the centuries and yet looks freshly made.

Title: Zoology 101
Description: Margot is researching strange things in Aeternum. She wants to know why there are Buffalo here. Investigate the area and gather samples and any notes you find regarding them.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" /> They are a species from a completely different part of the world from all others on Aeternum. There must be a reason.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_thinking" />Haven't discovered anything yet? That's okay. Take your time. The wonders of the world unfurl slowly in our fragile hands.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />What have you uncovered about our furry friends?

Title: A Wyrd and Wonderful World
Description: Margot has discovered a plant that seems to have strange properties. Gather sprigs of it and present them to people around Windsward to see what their reactions are.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />More people around here would be if they glimpsed the glory of Wyrdwood trees. Their beauty is trascendent.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_shrugBrief" />Wonder is a clandestine thing. It seldom shows its face to those who are in a hurry.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I see smiles on faces that were once dour because of you. To know that even one person breathes easier because of us is to have suceeded.

Title: This Mortal Sphere
Description: A group of archeologists have gone missing near an ancient tomb. Follow their trail and discover what has happened then report back to Elric Chapman.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Pardon me, I was mostly thinking aloud. Just north of here there's an ancient tomb with strange spheres around it.
InProgressResponse: No luck yet? Oh dear. Could be they are lost to time - just like my mother's affection. Buried under sand and dust…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You've survived! I was beginning to worry. What did you find?

Title: Creation Myths
Description: Elric has some interesting theories about the spheres. Follow his instructions and set them in place. Then report your findings back to him.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The spheres seem to store power. I believe that if you infuse them with enough azoth, they should be able to interact with other spheres nearby.
InProgressResponse: We'll discover the secrets of the Ancients, you and I. That'll prove my worth. Maybe then my mother will say something nice to me.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You've returned! Were you able to get a reaction from the spheres?

Title: Towering Tools
Description: Collect any remaining tools of the Ancients from Fallswatch Overlook and Mirador, then return to Antiquarian Pajitnova in Windsward.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Oh, well, I am an Antiquarian. Yelena Pajitnova. Nice to... meet you.
InProgressResponse: This view is magnificent, isn't it? How they built such wonders is beyond me. If you'll recover any tools you can find, I might have a better idea.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You have a gleam in your eye... you've found something? Let me see!

Title: Taken to Task
Description: Defeat Kisare the Taskmaster to acquire the Taskmaster's Heart. Then report back to Antiquarian Pajitnova in Windsward.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The kind you do with your hands. The funny thing is that we still don't even know what the Ancients look like.
InProgressResponse: Whatever elements you can recover from the corpse of the Taskmaster would be of greatest interest to me.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Did you defeat the Taskmaster? Amazing! Let me see what you found…

Title: Seeing Clearly (Expedition)
Description: Collect the Antiquarian's Eyepiece from Simon Grey in Amrine Excavation for Antiquarian Pajitnova in Windsward.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Simon. Simon Grey, one of the most brilliant researchers on Aeternum.
InProgressResponse: You must think me callous, wanting Simon's Eyepiece, but I have already mourned Simon's loss.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So it's true then? Simon Grey became Lost, his soul never able to be repaired. Very sad.

Title: Give a Dog a Bone (Expedition)
Description: Simon Grey's dog Barkimedes is awaiting his master's return and is very hungry. From what you can tell he would appreciate having some Ravager bones to gnaw on.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Sniff, sniff… Ruff! (Barkimedes sounds like he's hungry.)
InProgressResponse: (Barkimedes is panting eagerly, waiting for the bones.)
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Woof! (Barkimedes excitedly takes the bones… and promptly buries them.)
